About

Driven by
storytelling.

I'm a filmmaker focused on writing and direction — building a body of work that reflects both storytelling depth and visual intent. My work spans writing and directing my own projects, while also collaborating as a writer for other directors.

My pilot film ARASUR is currently in post-production, alongside two short-form indie projects made for digital platforms. For me, every story — whether an original film or a brand narrative — is a chance to create something purposeful and original. My Instagram serves as a living portfolio of this ongoing work.
